turns.input: *He punches Bram Kessel directly in the face.*
turns.narration:
Nicco's punch catches Bram square across the jaw. The big man staggers, catching himself on a nearby barrel. Flour puffs from his apron as he rights himself. His hand rises to his moustache, checking it, then to his reddening cheek.

Bram's eyes narrow. The friendly boom in his voice drops to something flatter. "You're buying something or you're leaving." He doesn't reach for anything, doesn't square up, but his body shifts to put the shop's interior behind him and the doorway nearer Nicco. "No credit for brawlers. No deliveries either."

He spits sideways, not quite at Nicco's feet, and waits.

Nicco is a 35-year-old human man. He was transported into this world from another world approximately one day before the campaign begins, and he has essentially no prior lived knowledge of this world unless explicitly established later. On arrival he became the lawful owner/holder of Heartstone Tower. He is tall and overweight, with a few visible white hairs and very mild, early balding; no further appearance details are established. His magical affinity/school is Light. His currently known Light subschools are healing and sacrifice, understood only within the existing magic framework; no mechanics for sacrifice are established. Being a Light mage gives him no automatic knowledge of spells, institutions, lore, or magical theory. Nicco is the player character: his dialogue, thoughts, intentions, and deliberate actions are supplied only by the player.
